services.name: DiagTrack
services.descriptionSimple: Microsoft telemetry and diagnostic tracking service.
services.descriptionTech: Collects diagnostic data and uploads to Microsoft endpoints. Safe to disable.
services.gamingImpact: Saves slight background CPU and network activity.

services.name: dmwappushservice
services.displayName: Device Management Wireless Application Protocol Push
services.descriptionSimple: WAP push message routing for telemetry.
services.descriptionTech: Routing service for diagnostic data and push messaging.

services.name: SysMain
services.descriptionSimple: Preloads frequently used apps into RAM. On SSDs leave it alone; on slow mechanical HDDs it can cause 100% disk usage.
services.descriptionTech: Maintains and improves system performance over time by caching. Disabling on NVMe SSDs harms game load times.
services.gamingImpact: DO NOT DISABLE ON FAST SSDs. Only disable if gaming on old rotational HDDs.

services.name: bthserv
services.descriptionSimple: DO NOT DISABLE! Powers Bluetooth for wireless controllers (Xbox/PS5), wireless gaming mice, and headsets.
services.descriptionTech: bthserv + BluetoothUserService. Required for Bluetooth RFCOMM, A2DP audio, and HID peripherals.
services.gamingImpact: CATASTROPHIC for wireless gaming accessories if disabled.

services.name: XboxGipSvc
services.descriptionSimple: Powers wired and wireless Xbox controllers and accessories. Gamers NEED this.
services.descriptionTech: GIP driver interface for Xbox controllers, headsets, and steering wheels.
services.gamingImpact: Disabling breaks Xbox controller firmware updates and wireless dongle connection.

services.name: XblAuthManager
services.descriptionSimple: Handles login and cloud saves for Game Pass and Xbox games. Keep enabled if you play games from MS Store.
services.descriptionTech: Xbox Live authentication provider. Required for Game Pass DRM checks.
services.gamingImpact: Disabling prevents any Xbox game or Game Pass game from launching.

services.name: Spooler
services.descriptionSimple: Manages printing. If you have no printer, disabling saves a tiny bit of RAM. If you ever print, leave ON.
services.descriptionTech: Spooler service for local and network print jobs.
